areaChart.description: Reference area geometry and interactions with Zeron color variables, shared axes, tooltips and range selection.
areaChart.overlap: Series overlap without stacking. Measures with different units use separate Y scales; series colors are explicitly assigned.
areaChart.dataBehavior: Only finite numbers are plotted. Missing, NaN and infinite observations remain gaps, including after downsampling; tooltip values show —. Invalid dates are excluded from the chronological plotting view; accessible raw data retains the original rows. Empty or undersized containers omit the SVG; the host supplies visible empty/error states.
areaChart.keyboardBehavior: Tab focuses the chart once. Arrow keys move between observations; Home/End reaches either boundary, Escape or blur clears the tooltip. Brush handles support arrow keys, Home/End and Escape.
areaChart.motionBehavior: Default entrance is 1100ms with a 500ms Y-domain transition. Reduced motion renders stable geometry and preserves status completion. Loading animation loops and observers are cleaned up on unmount.
areaChart.brushBehavior: Brush selection contains Date start/end. Passing selection enables controlled mode; null clears both the native selection and overlays. Omit it for initialSelection-based uncontrolled mode. Callbacks run during drag preview and commit; hosts own the selected range. Time outside the selection uses neutral gray with no Gaussian blur by default. The full track retains its border after clearing.
areaChart.compatibility: AreaChart uses the reference Visx composition and has no stackId API. Existing Recharts compositions remain available through Chart; these two APIs are separate.
areaChart.p0: Date key and raw observations. A chronological plotting view leaves input untouched.
areaChart.p1: 40px on each side; style can override aspect ratio and height.
areaChart.p2: Shared clip entrance; duration in milliseconds.
areaChart.p3: Motion transition override; signature changes replay entrance.
areaChart.p4: Status drives loading, exit, domain transition and reveal; callback reports the actual phase.
areaChart.p5: Interpolate Y-domain changes and specify duration.
areaChart.p6: Viewport, full slot count and Y-domain tweening when the brush changes the viewport.
areaChart.p7: Compose areas, axes, grid, tooltip and SVG definitions.
areaChart.p9: Default slot 1; explicitly assign stable colors to multiple series.
areaChart.p10: Gradient top opacity, bottom opacity and vertical span.
areaChart.p11: Visx curve factory; animate controls markers while the root owns shared clip entrance.
areaChart.p12: Fade both edges or a single edge.
areaChart.p13: Stroke, hover highlight and point markers.
areaChart.p14: Marker radius, fill, stroke, ring gap and hover appearance.
areaChart.p15: Observation index at which the dashed tail starts and dash pattern.
areaChart.p16: Override loading visibility, pulse mode or pulse/sweep style.
areaChart.p18: Use an instance-unique SVG pattern ID; pair with Area for the stroke.
areaChart.p19: Date start/end; omit selection for uncontrolled mode, null clears it.
areaChart.p20: Notifies during preview and commit; controlled hosts update selection.
areaChart.p21: Inactive ranges use neutral gray. Defaults: blurPx=0 and fadeOuterEdges=false; explicit overrides remain supported.
areaChart.p22: Default: one item per row. Inline keeps label/value pairs together. Wrap allows new rows; collapse puts items that do not fit behind an expandable disclosure.
areaChart.p23: Limit visible items while collapsed and customize the expand/collapse label. Collapsed items are excluded from keyboard navigation; expansion reveals every item.
